steps.content: [Black Screen Transition]
You wake up to a throbbing pain at the back of your head. You try to focus, but there's only darkness before your eyes. The air is tinged with the smell of rotting wood.
You blink.
[Blank Screen]
You blink again, harder this time.
[Blank Screen]
You can't tell if you've been blinded during the earlier confrontation or if you're simply sitting in pitch darkness. The only thing you know for certain is that you've been tied up.
The sailors must know a thing or two about knots. The twine binding you is fastened perfectly, just tight enough to prevent escape, but not overly so as to cut off circulation to your arms.
You twist your body and inch forward until your forehead touches cold, hard metal. Turning your head, you press your cheek against it, trying to feel its shape and position.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A cage...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Looks like I'm not the first person who's been here.
There's no immediate way to escape. You decide to use this moment to comb through what you already know.

You're now on the old warship you are to investigate. It's occupied by WhiteSands dwellers who are intensely hostile to outsiders, and there's also a Sinner among them. Though they claim to be rescuers, given your current predicament, perhaps you shouldn't believe their words.
But... lying here now, you remember days spent in similar darkness when you clutched a radio, waiting to hear Ark's voice. You want to believe her.
If you had another chance to talk with Ark, could things take a turn for the better?
There's also a last resort. Waiting for the FAC to rescue you. But considering Ark and her crew's attitude... things would no doubt get ugly.
[Door opening sound + Scene Change]
The sudden brightness stings your eyes, but you have no free hands to shield them.
Well, at least now you can confirm there's nothing wrong with your eyesight.
A tall figure appears in the doorway, approaching you step by step. It's Samuel.
He opens the cage, tosses a bowl in front of you, then quickly locks it again. As if you could possibly crawl out in those few seconds. As the bowl hits the ground, you catch the scent of food.
You shift your shoulders slightly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How am I supposed to eat this?

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: You don't need hands to eat. Just bow your head. Or you can choose to starve yourself to death. Makes no difference to me.
He speaks in fluent Disian, the words pronounced flawlessly.
A DisCity native on this ship? Your mind races with possibilities: Could he be a captive like you? Or perhaps he's somehow connected to the ship's origins?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you from DisCity?
Samuel raises an eyebrow.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: So what if I am? Don't try to get friendly with me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just a bit surprising is all. She kept calling me a DisCity thief earlier. I thought she had something against us.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: We didn't lock you up because you're from DisCity. You're a dog who belongs to the FAC, FCA, whatever it's called. Am I right?
You remain silent. Samuel lets out a contemptuous snort.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: I figured as much. I already told Ark that your appearance near our ship at this exact time was just too convenient.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Don't try to drive a wedge between us. It won't work. Besides, she's half Disian herself. I mean, she's... an immigrant. Her parents...
Suddenly realizing he's said too much, Samuel cuts himself off, and awkwardly licks his lips.
His boots shift on the floor with a few creaks, suggesting his exit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you really from DisCity? And you don't know about the FAC?
He stops in his tracks, then stomps several paces toward you, clearly fuming.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Am I really from DisCity?! When I left that place, this FAC thing didn't even exist yet!

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: A few years back, I met another punk like you, who said he'd escaped from some place called Syndicate. I asked where that shithole was, and he laughed at me and called me a fake.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: I was already hustling in West District before that kid's dad even thought of making that stupid mistake!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So you're from West District? I'm quite familiar with that area myself...
Samuel shuts you up with a dismissive wave of his hand.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Don't wanna hear it. That punk already told me West District is now controlled by gangs and thugs. It's no longer a place for decent folks.
His head dips slightly and his voice grows lower.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Just let me remember West District as it once was.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, then I've got some good news for you. Syndicate is now known as West District again.

So you share what you know about West District, recounting everything from the Black Ring eruption to the abolition of the West District Order Management Regulations, and the changes in the streets. Samuel gradually becomes entranced, leaning against the wall. In the dim light, you notice his eyes slowly softening.
When you finish, he finally smiles faintly and shakes his head.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Alright, I've heard enough. If you keep going, I'll start remembering things from my childhood.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's nothing wrong with reminiscing. Why don't you go back and see it for yourself sometime?
You shift your shoulders toward him again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's not like you're all tied up like me.
Samuel lets out a wry laugh and shakes his head.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: I was a deserter, to put it simply. I was only a teenager when I left DisCity, and that was... decades ago.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Who knows how many people I once knew are still alive? Even if they are, who would even remember me?

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Now, the Ark is my home. My commanding officer sent me to die, but the Ark saved me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand. But no matter how you look at it, life in WhiteSands is less stable than life in DisCity.
Samuel doesn't respond. You gesture with your chin toward the suspicious fluid in the bowl before you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this stuff only served to captives like me, or does everyone on the ship eat it?
Samuel remains silent. You let out a sigh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is your captain's specialty, right? Lizard stew...

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ... Just close your eyes, and it'll taste no different than chicken soup.
Samuel smiles and shakes his head.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Things haven't been good lately. We just weathered a sandstorm, and now we're constantly being harassed by DisCity warships, with no chance to dock anywhere...

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: This is the only food we've left. Ark told me to bring you some. She doesn't want anyone starving to death on our ship. After all, we're a rescue ship.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I was nearly blasted to pieces on this rescue ship of yours just a while ago.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: If Ark had really wanted to kill you, you'd have been roasted and tossed overboard to feed the sand beasts already.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: She tends to lose her temper when it comes to threats to our ship. She has indeed hurt hijackers before, but afterward she would be too guilty to sleep.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: But if you ask me, I wouldn't hesitate to feed those people to sand beasts.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: We've run into too many of those ******* bastards. If it weren't for Ark, we'd all have died several times over by now. Hmph. It wouldn't be the first time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What has happened on this ship?
Samuel's lips twitch, like he wants to speak but then thinks better of it. Finally, he just gives you a sidelong glance and sneers.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: There have been far too many like you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since you were once a DisCity soldier, you should understand better than anyone. This is a DisCorps warship, and I'm only here to conduct an official investigation. I have no intention of seizing your ship.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: So you're some big shot, huh?

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: But we couldn't care less about you and what kind of warship the Ark used to be. I've spent most of my life on this ship and I've watched over Ark since she was born. This ship means more than our lives, and no one can take her away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What you really want, is it this ship itself, or a home?
After a moment of silence, a heavy sigh comes from above.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Without this ship, where would our home even be?
Then, the floor creaks, and soon you're plunged back into boundless darkness.
As he opens the door, you call out to stop him.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you think of DisCity?
[Black Screen]
After Samuel is gone, you're once again enveloped in darkness, eventually drifting into sleep. You have no idea how much time has passed when a piercing alarm jolts you awake.
[Alarm sound effect + visual effect]

steps.speaker: Impatient Crew Member
steps.content: Hurry up! It's those damn warships again!

steps.speaker: Agitated Crew Member
steps.content: ****! Again? Ain't they got nothing better to do?!
Chaotic footsteps rush past your door, then fade away. You hold your breath, waiting patiently until the alarm finally stops and silence returns around you.
Just as the familiar darkness surrounds you again, you hear something metallic scraping faintly outside the door.
[Blank Screen + Door Opening & Footstep Sound Effects]
The lock on your cage clicks open and falls down. Samuel is standing before you.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Hurry! Your people say they're going to open fire!
He nervously glances over his shoulder while shoving a tool into your hands for you to cut the rope.
[Scene Change]
Chaos erupts across the deck. Crew members crowd around the gunwale, arguing heatedly. Out in the sands, several DisCity warships have completely surrounded them.
Ark rushes over. The moment the crew members spot her, they immediately wave her over.

But she doesn't even need to get close to know it's those stubborn DisCity warships again. Ever since they arrived in this region and caught DisCity's attention, people have been trying to board their ship every other day with different excuses, demanding they return the Ark.
This time, however, those Disians aren't just circling around them like flies—they've started buzzing like them too.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Hand over the hostage immediately! Or else...
All their main cannons are trained on the Ark, poised to fire.

steps.speaker: Amir
steps.content: They came out of nowhere! Our cannons aren't even warmed up yet. We're outgunned now...
On the opposing deck, a uniformed officer lowers his hand.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Ready!
The cannon muzzles rotate, rumbling thunderously.
But Ark just smiles. She tilts her head slightly, gently reassuring the crew member beside her.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Don't worry. Leave it all to me.
She raises her hand calmly.
With an ear-splitting boom, the opposing warship's main cannons launch instantly, spitting flames into the sky.
Mania energy radiates from her, spreading rapidly across the deck. The Ark vibrates in response, as if coming alive, all cannon muzzles firing in perfect unison.
[Blank Screen + Screen Shakes]
Artillery shells land beside the FAC sand ship, kicking up massive sand waves that nearly capsize the vessel. The soldiers aboard desperately cling to the railings to keep their balance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop it!
Your voice suddenly rings out. Ark's back stiffens with a jolt.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: So you want to die!
Ark whips around, her arm cannon already raised and aimed directly at you.
But when she finally sees what's happening, her voice nearly cracks.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Samuel?!
The tip of your wire cutter is pressed against Samuel's throat, flashing blindingly in the sunlight.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You, you...

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You Disian scum... Let him go! Or I'll kill you right now!

Ark charges at you like a lioness, roaring with rage. You can hardly believe such a furious sound is coming from such a small, thin frame. The deck beneath your feet rumbles ominously, as if the Ark herself shares her captain's fury toward you.
You quickly drag Samuel backward, retreating several steps.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Freeze! One more step and he's dead.
Ark immediately comes to a halt, glaring at you furiously, her weapon still raised and aimed at you.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You dare threaten me on my ship?!

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You think this stunt will get you off my ship safely? Dream on!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do exactly as I say, and we'll all walk away from this safely.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Listen carefully. I need you to come with me to DisCity. You and your crew won't be harmed. Otherwise...
You turn the metal pliers in your hand slowly, making sure she sees how the sharp tip could pierce through Samuel's throat.
Ark's eyes widen in fear, the color draining from her face. You feel a twinge of guilt, but you know this is no time for mercy.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: Why the hell should I trust you?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can choose to trust me and come along, or we can find out which is faster: your cannon, or...
You tighten your grip, cutting a small incision on Samuel's neck. Bright red drops of blood trickle down his throat. He shudders violently but remains silent, eyes squeezed shut.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well? Want to gamble with his life?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Make your choice, Ark. How much longer he can hold on is entirely up to you.
Her eyes dart back and forth between your face and Samuel's before finally fixing on you with an intense stare.
Her hands slowly clench into fists, knuckles turning white from the pressure.
After a brief silence, she finally speaks with a trembling voice.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: ...Okay.

steps.speaker: Ark
steps.content: You win. I'll go with you.
[Scene Change]
The night before
What do you think of DisCity?

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Are you inviting us to rot in a DisCity prison cell?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, I want to help you. If I can confirm you pose no threat to others, I'll convince the DisCity authorities to grant you protection. The Ark might even be allowed to stay. I just need Ark to come with me. But I promise, I won't harm her.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Wow. Just what kind of big-time position do you hold in DisCity? Does the entire city obey your orders?
You let out a sigh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not far from the truth. And that's why if I were to go missing, the FAC wouldn't let you off so easily.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ...Are you threatening me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm merely stating a fact.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To defend the ship, Ark would probably launch some suicidal attack on them. Though you may not be familiar with the FAC, you must realize that if you were to clash with DisCity's armed forces, you wouldn't stand a chance.
His eyes flashed at the mention of Ark's name. He approached slowly, raised his hand, then slammed his fist against your cage.
You remain unfazed, lifting your head to stare directly into his eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I contacted the FAC as soon as I boarded the ship. The rescue team will arrive within twenty-four hours.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When that time comes, the choice will be in your hands.
